configuration.functional.title: Functional configurations
configuration.functional.exitBehavior.ti: What closing the main window does. "Minimize to tray" keeps background tasks running. The "Remember my choice" box in the exit dialog writes to this setting, and you can change it back here at any time.
configuration.backup.title: Version backups
configuration.backup.description: When enabled, the first launch of a different version backs up the previous version's core databases and settings. Backups exclude resource files, covers, dependent components and temporary files.
configuration.backup.retentionNote: The default is the most recent 7 versions. Changes apply on the next startup: older version backups beyond the limit are removed while automatic backups are enabled.
configuration.backup.invalidVersions: Enter a valid positive whole number.
configuration.backup.disable.title: Disable automatic backups?
configuration.backup.disable.warning: Future version upgrades will no longer automatically back up core databases and settings. If an upgrade fails or data is damaged, you may be unable to recover the state before the upgrade. Confirm that you understand this risk and will keep any backups you need yourself.
configuration.backup.disable.preserved: Existing backups are kept. You can re-enable automatic backups at any time.
configuration.backup.disable.confirm: I understand the risk, disable backups
configuration.contact.title: Contact us
configuration.appInfo.title: System information
configuration.appInfo.updateCheckUnavail: This deployment does not support built-in update checks. For Docker, replace the image; for a source deployment, rebuild or replace the program. Keep the existing data directory in both cases. Desktop auto-updates require an app installed through the installer.
configuration.appInfo.channelBehind: {{channel}} channel offers {{latest}}, older than the installed {{installed}}
configuration.appInfo.channelBehind.tip: The newest release this channel can offer is older than what you have installed, so it will never report a new version. If you are running a pre-release build, turn on "Receive beta updates".
configuration.appInfo.runningVersionMism: The running program is {{running}}, but the installation records {{installed}} — what a locally built copy dropped into the install directory looks like. Update checks always compare against the recorded {{installed}}, not against the version shown here.
configuration.legacyNotice.title: Old installation data detected
configuration.legacyNotice.description: Starting with 2.3, upgrades wipe the previous install directory; data written there by older versions is no longer referenced and can be backed up + deleted to free space.
configuration.dataPath.error.title: Cannot relocate
configuration.dataPath.confirm.copyNote: Existing data will be copied to the new location after restart. Do not power off or kill the process until done.
configuration.dataPath.confirm.useOrMerg: Target folder already contains Bakabase data (version: {{version}}). Pick how to proceed:
configuration.dataPath.confirm.option.us: Flip the pointer to the target. No files copied. Current data stays at the original location and can be cleaned up manually later. A backup or a copied installation isn't detected automatically. Disconnect before restarting into it, and complete the matching step under Devices and sharing → Advanced → After copying or restoring data before reconnecting.
configuration.dataPath.confirm.option.me: Copy current data to the target. Same-name files are overwritten; other files at the target (e.g. caches) are preserved.
configuration.dataPath.confirm.merge.war: Same-name files at the target will be overwritten with current data. Unrelated files are preserved. Confirm to proceed.
configuration.dataPath.confirm.merge.typ: Type the phrase below verbatim to confirm:
configuration.dataPath.confirm.merge.phr: I understand the risk, confirm merge
configuration.dataPath.restart.title: Restart required to complete migration
configuration.dataPath.restart.body: Migration is staged. Bakabase will switch to the new data path on restart.
configuration.dataPath.validation.inside: This path is inside the Bakabase install directory ({{installRoot}}). Upgrades replace files inside it, and uninstall or Repair wipes the install directory wholesale — any data here will be lost with it. Choose a location outside the install directory.
configuration.dataPath.validation.circul: Target and current path contain each other.
configuration.dataPath.validation.noWrit: No write permission for the target.
configuration.dataPath.validation.insuff: Insufficient free space on the target disk.
configuration.appInfo.tip.appDataPath: This is where core data files stored and DO NOT change them if not necessary. The logs in [System] - [Logs] are saved in bootstrap_log.* files, they can be safely deleted.
configuration.appInfo.tip.appDataPath.ma: For Import existing data, follow the setup wizard. The following applies only to manually copying or restoring an entire data directory: prepare the local data, disconnect from the network and fully close Bakabase before overwriting it. Start offline, choose the matching option under Devices and sharing → Advanced → After copying or restoring data, then reconnect. This is unnecessary when only moving the same data without restoring an older copy.
configuration.appInfo.tip.appDataPath.in: Data kept inside the application install directory is removed when you uninstall Bakabase or run "Repair" from the installer. To keep it, switch the path to a directory outside the install tree first.
configuration.appInfo.tip.appDataPath.sy: This data directory is inside a Windows system folder. Some files may need elevated permission to write. Move the data to a directory your user can write to.
configuration.appInfo.tip.anchorPath: Where the data directory's redirect file lives. When you customise the data directory, the app writes a small pointer file here so the next launch knows where to find your data.
configuration.appInfo.tip.dataPath: This is where user files, covers, and other data are stored.
configuration.appInfo.tip.tempFilesPath: This is a directory where temporary files are stored.
configuration.appInfo.tip.logPath: Detailed information which describing the running states of app. You can send log files to developer if the app is not running normally, and you can delete them also if everything is ok.
configuration.appInfo.tip.backupPath: When automatic backups are enabled, the first launch of a different version backs up core databases and settings, with retention controlled by Version backups. Backups exclude resource files, covers, dependent components and temporary files. Check version compatibility before restoring. A full overwrite also brings back old sharing and management access: disconnect first, and after starting, complete the matching step under Devices and sharing → Advanced → After copying or restoring data before reconnecting.
configuration.others.title: Other settings
configuration.others.proxy.tip: You can set a proxy for network requests, such as socks5://127.0.0.1:18888
configuration.others.proxy.name: Name
configuration.others.proxy.test.title: Test proxy — {{name}}
configuration.others.enablePreRelease.ti: Prefer beta version which has new features but less stability
configuration.others.enableTracking.tip: We use Microsoft Clarity (session recordings / heatmaps), Google Analytics 4 (feature usage / version distribution), and Sentry (error diagnostics) to improve product quality. We never collect file paths, file names, library contents, or account information. You can turn this off at any time.
configuration.others.maxParallelism.tip: Degree of parallelism for CPU-intensive operations. Set to 1 for minimum utilization. Leave empty for default (half of CPU cores).
configuration.development.title: Development
configuration.development.tip.configurab: The configurable port range is {{min}}-{{max}}. And you can set it to 0 for auto count.
configuration.development.tip.changesAft: Changes will take effect after restarting the application
configuration.development.tip.portWarnin: Please be careful when setting this value, if you set it to a value that is already in use by another application, our application will not be able to start.
configuration.development.tip.portsInput: Enter ports separated by commas, e.g. 34567, 34568
configuration.development.error.tooManyP: Too many ports. Up to {{max}} ports are supported.
configuration.ai.title: AI / LLM
configuration.ai.noProviders: No providers configured. Add one to get started.
configuration.ai.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this provider?
configuration.ai.featureConfigs.descript: Configure provider and model for each AI feature
configuration.ai.feature.defaultConfigWa: Editing global default config. Changes will affect all features using the default.
configuration.ai.usage.title: Usage Statistics
configuration.ai.auditLog.title: Audit Log
configuration.ai.quota.title: Quota
configuration.ai.quota.enableAuditConten: When enabled, request and response summaries will be logged for debugging. Increases storage usage.
configuration.ai.cache.title: Cache
configuration.ai.cache.clearConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear all cache?
configuration.ai.cache.searchPlaceholder: Search by model or cache key...
configuration.remoteAccess.mode.label: Access from other devices
configuration.remoteAccess.mode.tip: Bakabase listens on the network either way; this decides whether anything other than this machine is served. Every device that can reach it is trusted — there is no login — so keep this to a network you trust and do not port-forward it.
configuration.remoteAccess.address.label: Address for other devices
configuration.remoteAccess.address.tip: Open one of these on the other device. Which one works depends on the network it is joined to.
configuration.remoteAccess.address.none: No network interface is currently reachable.
configuration.remoteAccess.liveTranscode: Allow live transcoding for other devices

Some videos need re-encoding before a browser can play them, which keeps this machine's CPU busy for as long as the viewer watches. Off, other devices are told to use a native player for those videos instead.
configuration.remoteAccess.unrestrictedW: Other devices can also delete files, change settings and launch programs on this machine. Actions that open a window will do so on this screen, not theirs.
configuration.remoteAccess.requirePairin: Off, any device on the network can browse and watch. On, a device has to be paired first — either by typing a code from here, or by asking an already-paired device to approve it. This machine is never affected.
configuration.remoteAccess.pairingCode.t: Type this on the other device to pair it. Only one code is valid at a time, it is good for a single device, and it is burned after a few wrong guesses.
configuration.remoteAccess.pairingCode.s: Shown only here, expires in {{minutes}} min. Generate a new one if you lose it.
configuration.remoteAccess.pairingCode.o: A code is active — expires in {{minutes}} min, {{attempts}} attempts left.
configuration.remoteAccess.pending.label: Waiting to be let in
configuration.remoteAccess.pending.tip: Devices that asked an already-paired device to approve them. Check the name and address before approving.
configuration.remoteAccess.devices.label: Paired devices
configuration.remoteAccess.devices.tip: Revoking a device takes effect immediately: its next request is refused, its open connection is dropped, and any media link it was handed stops working.
configuration.remoteAccess.devices.revok: {{name}} will be disconnected and will have to pair again to get back in.
configuration.remoteAccess.title: Remote access
configuration.dataPath.restart.body.serv: The move is set up. Restarting the server switches it to the new data path; this window will reconnect to it once it is back.
configuration.dependency.installedOnTheS: These are installed on the server and used by it. Installing one from here installs it there.
configuration.appInfo.identityRecovery.l: Devices and sharing → Advanced → After copying or restoring data
configuration.appInfo.identityRecovery.o: Do this on the device that stores this library: Devices and sharing → Advanced → After copying or restoring data.
configuration.dataImport.error: Unable to import. Check the directory and try again.
configuration.dataImport.restartTitle: Import queued; restart the app or server
configuration.dataImport.restartBody: The directory below is the source of existing data. The next startup will back up and replace current data.
configuration.dataImport.restartInstruct: For the desktop app, quit normally and reopen it. For a standalone server, stop it and run the original start command again. For Docker Compose, use the command below.
configuration.dataImport.keepSource: Until the operation completes, keep the Bakabase instance using the source data directory stopped, and keep its directory and mount accessible.
configuration.dataImport.monitorHelp: Open this page before restarting. It can show copying, backup, verification and startup status while the main interface is disconnected, and retries automatically when the connection changes.
configuration.dataImport.reconnecting: The main server is temporarily unavailable. The last known status is shown below. Import may still be running; open the separate progress page to check. Do not restart again just because the connection was lost.
configuration.dataImport.completedNotice: Import completed and the server has started.
configuration.dataImport.longRunning: Copying a large directory or verifying databases can take time. Check the separate progress page and avoid restarting again or stopping the server process.
configuration.dataImport.backupPath: Backup of the previous server data
configuration.dataImport.setupIntro: Choose existing data and confirm the import in the shared setup and maintenance page. The source can be a desktop app or another Bakabase server. Opening this page does not change existing data.
configuration.dataImport.setupFailed: Unable to open setup and maintenance. Please try again.
configuration.dataRelocation.error: Unable to change the data directory. Please try again.
configuration.dataRelocation.restartTitl: Restart to change the data directory
configuration.dataRelocation.restartBody: The destination has been confirmed. On restart, current data will be copied and the app will switch to this directory.
configuration.dataRelocation.restartInst: For the desktop app, quit normally and reopen it. For a standalone server, stop it and run the original start command again.
configuration.dataRelocation.keepSource: Keep both directories accessible until the switch completes. Data in the old directory is retained; remove it only after checking the new directory works.
configuration.dataRelocation.monitorHelp: Open this page before restarting to follow copying, verification and startup. It reconnects automatically while the main service is unavailable.
configuration.dataRelocation.reconnectin: The main service is temporarily unavailable. This is the last known state. Check the separate progress page; do not restart repeatedly.
configuration.dataRelocation.completedNo: The data directory has changed and the service is ready.
configuration.dataRelocation.longRunning: Copying a large directory or verifying databases can take time. Check the separate progress page and avoid restarting again or stopping the server process.
configuration.dataRelocation.setupIntro: Choose and confirm a data directory in the shared setup and maintenance page. Opening it does not move existing data.
configuration.dataRelocation.setupFailed: Unable to open setup and maintenance. Please try again.
configuration.dataImport.restartBodyNewD: On restart, data will be imported into the new directory. The location switches after verification. Your current directory is retained; libraries are not merged.
configuration.dataImport.retainedDataHel: Verify the new directory before cleaning up the original. Do not run the old copy at the same time.
configuration.dataImport.automaticQueued: Your choices are confirmed. Bakabase will save and close the current app, apply the change and start it again automatically. Open the separate progress page; no manual restart is needed.
configuration.dataImport.automaticStoppi: Waiting for the app to save and release its data files. Data processing begins after the app exits safely; the independent setup page stays available.
configuration.dataImport.automaticFailur: Setup has stopped this operation and will not retry automatically. Open the separate progress page, fix the reported cause, then restart Bakabase or its container to recover from the saved record. Preserve the data directories.
configuration.dataImport.automaticMonito: The independent setup page remains available while the main app is closed. A disconnect does not mean completion; wait for a confirmed result.
configuration.dataImport.stoppingLongRun: The app is still saving or waiting for background tasks. Setup continues waiting for its files to be released; no new progress does not mean failure.
configuration.dataRelocation.automaticQu: Your choices are confirmed. Bakabase will save and close the current app, apply the change and start it again automatically. Open the separate progress page; no manual restart is needed.
configuration.dataRelocation.automaticSt: Waiting for the app to save and release its data files. Data processing begins after the app exits safely; the independent setup page stays available.
configuration.dataRelocation.automaticFa: Setup has stopped this operation and will not retry automatically. Open the separate progress page, fix the reported cause, then restart Bakabase or its container to recover from the saved record. Preserve the data directories.
configuration.dataRelocation.automaticMo: The independent setup page remains available while the main app is closed. A disconnect does not mean completion; wait for a confirmed result.
configuration.dataRelocation.stoppingLon: The app is still saving or waiting for background tasks. Setup continues waiting for its files to be released; no new progress does not mean failure.
